name: syspage_format
description: System Page (Page 1) and Master Catalog layout definitions for WebDB
criticalWarning: CRITICAL WARNING: FROZEN SYSTEM PAGES & CATALOG SPECIFICATION
DO NOT modify the order or length of existing fields in Page 1, catalog
descriptors, or dedicated column catalog pages!
Changing any layout defined here WILL corrupt existing database files,
render databases unreadable, and permanently break schema decoding.
Any new metadata fields MUST be appended within designated RESERVED areas

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LENGTH
constants.description: Maximum length in bytes for table and column names (UTF-8, null-padded).

layouts.sizeDescription: Total size in bytes of the database file header in Page 1 (100 bytes).

fields.name: PAGE_SIZE
fields.description: 6..7: Page size in bytes (4096, uint16 LE)

fields.name: MIN_READ_VERSION
fields.description: 10..11: Minimum engine read version required (uint16 LE)

fields.name: TOTAL_PAGES
fields.description: 12..15: Total number of pages in database file (uint32 LE)

fields.name: FREE_PAGE_HEAD
fields.description: 16..19: Page ID of the first free page in the free list chain (uint32 LE)

fields.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
fields.description: 20..23: User schema version cookie, bumped on DDL (uint32 LE)

fields.name: NEXT_CATALOG_PAGE_ID
fields.description: 32..35: Chained catalog page pointer (always 0 in v1, uint32 LE)

fields.name: NEXT_INDEX_CATALOG_PAGE_ID
fields.description: 36..39: Chained index catalog pointer (always 0 in v1, uint32 LE)

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: 40..99: Reserved space for future file header extensions (zero-padded)

layouts.sizeDescription: Total size in bytes of a single table descriptor record (128 bytes).
Total size in bytes of a single index descriptor record (128 bytes).
Total size in bytes of a dedicated column catalog page header (16 bytes).

fields.name: COL_COUNT_IN_PAGE
fields.description: uint16_t columns stored in this page (0..56)

fields.name: TABLE_ID
fields.description: uint16_t table_id this page belongs to

fields.name: NEXT_COL_CATALOG_PAGE_ID
fields.description: uint32_t next column catalog pageId (0 = tail)

layouts.sizeDescription: Total size in bytes of a single column metadata record (72 bytes).

fields.name: COL_OFFSET
fields.description: uint16_t fixed-slice offset or var-table index

partitionConstants.name: MAX_TABLES_SYSPAGE
partitionConstants.description: Maximum number of table descriptors that fit in Page 1 (16).

partitionConstants.name: MAX_INDEXES_SYSPAGE
partitionConstants.description: Maximum number of index descriptors that fit in Page 1 (8).

partitionConstants.name: MASTER_TABLE_OFFSET
partitionConstants.description: Byte offset where master table descriptors start in Page 1 (byte 100).

partitionConstants.name: INDEX_CATALOG_OFFSET
partitionConstants.description: Byte offset where index descriptors start in Page 1 (100 + 16 * 128 = 2148).

partitionConstants.name: NEXT_DESCRIPTOR_CATALOG_PAGE_OFFSET
partitionConstants.description: Byte offset for chained descriptor page pointer (2148 + 8 * 128 = 3172).

partitionConstants.name: NEXT_DESCRIPTOR_CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE
partitionConstants.description: Size in bytes of chained descriptor catalog page pointer (4 bytes).

partitionConstants.name: SYSPAGE_RESERVED_OFFSET
partitionConstants.description: Byte offset for Page 1 reserved partition (3172 + 4 = 3176).

partitionConstants.name: SYSPAGE_RESERVED_SIZE
partitionConstants.description: Size in bytes of Page 1 reserved partition (4096 - 3176 = 920).

partitionConstants.name: MAX_COLUMNS_PER_CATALOG_PAGE
partitionConstants.description: Maximum column records per catalog page: floor((4096 - 16) / 72) = 56.

partitionConstants.name: MAX_COLUMNS_PER_TABLE
partitionConstants.description: Maximum columns supported per table across all catalog pages (256).
